scope: One user-authorized fresh paid GDD author/inspect/revise/verify acceptance. Later author batches were not dispatched. Original product documents, receipts, snapshots and logs were not manually edited; this is a separate observer record.

hostWorkflow.inspect: Recorded F-01: 25 handoff section references omit actual numbered heading prefixes. Reused supplied structural/reference results; no unchanged checker rerun.
hostWorkflow.revision: Native reviser made four grouped edits to readiness/output section strings, not body rules. Ran one handoff check after changed inputs; preserved finding F-01 and did not certify its own closure.
hostWorkflow.verify: Fresh native verifier checked affected references against saved headings, closed F-01, and host released batch 0. No second automatic revision or owner-resolution run.

postRunReadOnlyChecks.referencesBatch1: valid, issues=[], checked 21 references; future documents remain scheduled dependencies

hostWorkflow.reportScopeCaveat: summary.json deterministicDiagnostics was computed after state advanced to authorBatch=1 and therefore lists unwritten future three-document inputs. These are not batch-0 release failures. The explicit batch-1 CLI checks (one-based GDD batch) above correctly validate the delivered GDD scope. Original summary remains unchanged.

observerAcceptance.basis: Read complete final saved GDD and compare actual clauses, confirmed brief, professional ownership and next-consumer readiness. Host structural success and reviewer statements are not semantic proof.
observerAcceptance.findingAuthor: Codex observer after native workflow, not the BGS reviewer

sections: 6.2 侦测三阶段（游玩中的警戒状态，非游戏流程状态）
findings.sourceA: 未察觉：玩家不在任何守卫的有效视野内。
findings.sourceB: 已发现（追击）：侦测进度满时守卫发现玩家，立即转入追击，向玩家当前位置移动；玩家脱离全部视野后，守卫在失去目标计时结束后回到巡逻路线。
findings.counterexample: 玩家已经被发现并被追击，随后脱离全部守卫视野，而失去目标计时尚未结束。按 A 已属于未察觉，按 B 守卫仍处于追击。类似地，脱离视野但侦测进度仍在消退时，未察觉的定义没有排除残余警戒。
findings.downstreamImpact: 正文称其为三个警戒阶段，并要求向玩家反馈当前阶段，却未区分可见性与警戒记忆、每守卫状态与全局信息。技术状态执行、视觉警戒反馈和音频阶段映射必须自行选择一个解释。
findings.closeWhen: GDD owner明确三个阶段的判定与退出条件，使失去视野、警戒消退及追击计时未结束时的状态有唯一解释；明确每守卫状态与全局反馈之间的关系。无需在 GDD 选择具体计时数值或规定 UI/音色实现。

observerAcceptance.limits: This records one confirmed semantic ambiguity, not an exhaustive zero-defect claim or proof of playability. No new findings were injected into BGS state, receipts or paid model inputs, and no follow-up paid revision was started.

tokenObservation.basis: Final provider usage once per model call; input/output/cache are separate and cache is included in total. Not settled credits.
tokenObservation.unmeasured: Non-model request 1 was an HTTP401 authentication probe with missing usage; missing usage is not asserted as zero spend. Credit observations before/after both failed with billing_observation_transport_failed.

previousRunComparison.limits: One sample each, different generated drafts; previous run stopped at invalid Inspect receipt while current also completed Revision and Verify. No stable cost or settled-credit guarantee.

operationalObservations.minorSourceLookupDetour: All three fresh children first tried workspace/GDD.md, then used Glob and read workspace/docs/GDD.md. Each wrong-path Read was a normal file-not-found, not a checker outage. This remaining repeated lookup cost is not treated as a new automatic retry loop or silently fixed during acceptance.
operationalObservations.semanticReviewLimit: Inspect explicitly claimed detection phases and core rules were consistent but recorded only the host-provided structural issue. Targeted Verify correctly stayed with that structural correction; it did not remedy the earlier missed semantic ambiguity.
